mixed-port: 7890
mode: rule

proxies:
  - name: "🇩🇪 Germany #1"
    type: trojan
    server: de1.example.com
    port: 443
    password: p1
    sni: de1.example.com
  - name: "🇳🇱 Netherlands #1"
    type: trojan
    server: nl1.example.com
    port: 443
    password: p2
    sni: nl1.example.com

proxy-providers:
  public:
    type: http
    url: https://example.com/public/provider.txt
    interval: 3600
    path: ./proxy_providers/public.yaml

proxy-groups:
  - name: "🌙 Main"
    type: select
    proxies: ["💎 Trial", "🌏 Public", "🇩🇪 Germany #1", "🇳🇱 Netherlands #1"]
  - name: "💎 Trial"
    type: fallback
    url: https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
    proxies: ["🇩🇪 Germany #1", "🇳🇱 Netherlands #1"]
  - name: "🌏 Public"
    type: select
    proxies: ["⚡ Auto", "🇩🇪 Germany | 🇳🇱 Netherlands"]
  - name: "⚡ Auto"
    type: url-test
    use: [public]
    url: https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
  - name: "🇩🇪 Germany | 🇳🇱 Netherlands"
    type: url-test
    use: [public]
    filter: "^(?:🇩🇪 DE|🇳🇱 NL) "
    url: https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300

rules:
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,example.ru,DIRECT
  - AND,((NETWORK,UDP),(DST-PORT,443)),REJECT
  - GEOIP,RU,DIRECT
  - MATCH,🌙 Main
